body:
6 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories:

Laced vapes: what is in them, how they reach children, and how to report sellers (Rochdale). Vapes sold to children as cannabis oil are being found to contain spice, a far stronger synthetic drug that has put young people in hospital.

Rochdale Christmas Toy Appeal aims to deliver 10,000 gifts to children in need (Rochdale). Rochdale Borough Council's Christmas Toy Appeal seeks donations to provide gifts for 3,000 children living in poverty this festive season.

Heywood residents praised for Remembrance tributes on Armistice Day (Heywood). Thousands gathered in Heywood and Rochdale to honour war heroes during Remembrance Sunday and Armistice Day commemorations, with heartfelt tributes and moments of silence.

Measles: the symptoms to look out for in your child, and when to get help (Rochdale). More than 1,000 measles cases have been confirmed in England this year, 111 of them in the North West. Here is how the illness starts and the warning signs that need urgent care.

Rochdale to face York City again after April title decider (Rochdale). Rochdale will meet York City in League Two, marking their first encounter since last season's thrilling title decider in the National League.

Rochdale IT provider offers solutions for email disruptions during Microsoft outages (Rochdale). Rochdale-based IT provider No Fuss IT has urged local businesses to consider alternative communication methods in light of recent Microsoft 365 outages that disrupted email services.

Weather: Partly cloudy 7°C in Rochdale today.
